name: comp-371

frames.best_why: Menu open with three rows ticked and Remix still greyed out and disabled.

tagline: A menu of framework names where each row can be ticked on or off.
summary: A dropdown of checkbox options. Opening it reveals four named rows, any that are on show a tick at the right, and one row is disabled.
appearance: A dark outlined button reading Checkbox items with a small chevron. Opened, a rounded dark menu lists Next.js, SvelteKit, Remix and Astro, each with a tick at its right when selected; Remix is dimmed.
behaviour: Clicking the trigger opens a menu of four rows. Each row toggles a tick when picked, the menu stays open for more choices, and the disabled Remix row never responds.
demo_content: Framework names Next.js, SvelteKit, Remix and Astro.
search_phrases: pick several options from a list
toggle items on and off in a menu
checklist that opens from a button
choose more than one from a dropdown
use_when: Several independent options must be toggled at once without leaving the menu, as with tag or column filters.
avoid_when: The trigger shows no summary of what is checked, so people must reopen it to see the current filters.
customise: Option names and their starting ticks are fixed in the file, so changing the list means editing the source; the trigger label and button style come from shared pieces.
weight_why: A small menu with four rows and CSS state changes; no animation loop.

a11y.note: Real menu semantics and a properly disabled item are present, but the trigger never says which options are on.

issues: The trigger never shows which frameworks are currently checked.
polish_why: Even row heights and a clear tick column; the disabled row's contrast is borderline.
title: Checkbox Dropdown Menu
